primitives.name: OperationFamily
primitives.statement: There is a family of operations on a carrier.
primitives.operational_definition: A finite or indexed signature of k-ary operations.

primitives.name: EquivalenceRelation
primitives.statement: There is an equivalence relation on the carrier.

definitions.name: FamilywiseCongruence
definitions.statement: The equivalence is a congruence for every operation in the preserved signature.

definitions.name: QuotientSignature
definitions.statement: Each operation descends to equivalence classes.

definitions.name: SignatureProjection
definitions.statement: Maps each carrier element to its equivalence class while preserving all descended operations.

claims.statement: Familywise congruence is sufficient for all preserved operations to descend to the quotient.
If all preserved operations are representative-independent on quotient classes, the equivalence is a congruence for every operation.
The quotient projection preserves the entire descended operation signature.
Preservation of one operation does not imply preservation of another operation.
Effective physical descriptions may be characterized by approximate congruence over a selected signature of operations and observables.

observables.name: CongruencePartition
observables.definition: A carrier partition preserving all operations in the selected signature.

falsifiers.condition: Give a familywise congruence whose descended operation family depends on representative choice.
Give well-defined quotient operations for a signature where the equivalence fails compatibility with at least one operation.

metadata.purpose: Generalize quotient congruence from one operation to a preserved operation family.
